title: First live mainnet premium procurement creation
claim: The identified Ethereum mainnet transaction executed the first successful createPremiumJobWithDiscovery(job, proc) reference recorded by the public AGIJobManager Prime console and created the corresponding settlement job and discovery procurement with the stated reference economics.
proves: The public Prime console records jobId 0 and procurementId 0 for its canonical live reference.
The public reference identifies the stated escrow, reserve and total maximum exposure.
does_not_prove: Truth, quality or completion of any future off-chain work product.
Independent validation or responsible customer acceptance of a future mission.
Legal, security, regulatory or commercial suitability for another context.
